Market today: The mood is cautiously optimistic for tech, driven by Treasury yields pulling back from multi-decade highs. This offers some relief for growth stocks, which typically benefit from lower rates.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.27%) and SPAL (-36.54%) are both leveraged ETFs showing significant drawdowns and need immediate attention. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-10.47%) is also flagged for a trim.

Watch: Keep an eye on bond market movements and any further geopolitical developments, as these can quickly shift market sentiment for your concentrated portfolio.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged positions and protecting capital in this volatile environment.
plays: SPAL has broken its stop at 21.38; consider exiting this new, leveraged position to prevent further losses.
Consider trimming SOXL given its leveraged nature and significant drawdown; manage risk on this volatile position.
Consider trimming SMH to reduce overall chip exposure, especially given its current drawdown.
